name: Site safety: type a policy, watch it apply (Pexels footage)
description: A construction site and a warehouse play on a loop as two cameras. Type a policy on the demo page and it applies to both at once: each person gets a box and their gear checks (hard hat, hi-vis vest). Each camera is judged as a whole frame, so there are no zones to draw. Gear verdicts come from demo/ppe_verdicts.json, so the demo works offline; PolicyLens never identifies who anyone is.
policy: Workers at the construction site need to wear a vest and a helmet.
